title: Quaint Comforting American Pumpkin Casserole
description: A sour, flaky, comforting American dish featuring ginger and miso-marinate, made with ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly ingredients. This casserole is perfect for a cold winter evening.

ingredients.name: pumpkin puree
ingredients.notes: canned or fresh, cooked and mashed

instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the miso paste, ginger, and olive oil.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the bowl and mix well.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the flour, buttermilk, salt, and black pepper.
Add the pumpkin puree to the flour mixture and mix until smooth.
Add the pumpkin mixture to the miso mixture and mix until well combined.
Pour the mixture into a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Bake for 35 minutes or until the casserole is set and the top is lightly browned.
